evaluation-system.goal: Evaluate agent session quality, calibrate criteria, detect drift, patrol integrity, extract strategies
evaluation-system.summary: Process-oriented evaluation app. Five lanes: aftermath, deep-eval, drift, patrol, strategy. Criteria versioned. Individual evaluations are DB records, not tree nodes.

pipeline-health.goal: Monitor evaluation pipeline: is aftermath keeping up? Are there gaps? Is LLM lane useful?
pipeline-health.summary: Pipeline health monitoring. Aftermath evaluates ~800 sessions/day. LLM lane runs ~20/day with avg quality 0.72.

criteria-and-calibration.goal: Maintain scoring criteria, calibrate against human reviews, version criteria changes
criteria-and-calibration.summary: Criteria at v1. Calibration data: consistency-flags, human-reviews, re-evaluations all contain only 2026-04-29 placeholder stubs. No fresh disagreement data yet.

drift-detection.goal: Detect per-agent behavioral drift. Classify: natural evolution vs regression.

system-integrity.goal: Patrol system compliance. Monitor active session health. Flag anomalies.
system-integrity.summary: Patrol currently returns CRITICAL only for missing compliance-snapshot.json (known baseline gap).

strategy-learning.goal: Extract successful strategies from high-scoring sessions. Feed back into agent guidance.
